description: Basic concepts of acids and bases, and periodicity and chemistry of most main group elements are covered in this course. Topics include Bronsted and Lewis acids and bases, hard and soft acid- base concept, and group trends and general properties of metals and non-metals.
prerequisite: if undertaking an Undergraduate Degree then ( must have completed 1 of 0009 at a grade of at least AO, 09 CHEMISTRY/ADD. CHEMISTRY / 63 CHEMISTRY at a grade of at least E )
title: Inorganic Chemistry 1
